note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the circumstance and the clauses are generic placeholders, never real contract text. "Provided" and "undescribed" are supplied states of the circumstance, of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke); the configured link is a plain relation (no arrowhead, never a cause) and the bracket only MARKS the supplied section. No rule on conditions is stated: no condition precedent or subsequent, no fulfilment, no automatic effect, no clause that becomes due, binding or enforceable, and no jurisdiction. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the circumstance card and the clause cards stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions, priorities (no priority or order between clauses is drawn) and elements (the elements are the motif's own objects — contract plate, circumstance panel and card, section panel and cards, bracket — whose texts are editable through contract, panels, circumstance, stateLabels and clauses). No stress field is capped.
